text_block_list.text:
One day, after running through countless 
races—

Eishin Flash was set to be honored for 
setting a certain record.
That is—

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash-san has won many GⅠ races 
right here at this racecourse—Tokyo 
Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Congratulations!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, it's a GⅠ! A GⅠ! A magnificent 
record that will go down in history!

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Truly a "Tokyo Specialist"! The champion 
of Tokyo is Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am no champion, but... I shall take that 
as a compliment.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Could we get a word from the 
ever-cool Eishin Flash regarding this 
record?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. First of all, thank you very much for 
setting up this opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thinking back to three years ago, the very 
first race I ever watched in Japan was 
held at Tokyo Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That day, I only intended to go observe 
what Japanese races were like, but—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I was instantly captivated by the high 
level of competition. I swore in my heart 
that I wanted to make my mark here, tooâ

Pausing there, Eishin Flash glanced over 
at me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
With the support of so many people, I was 
able to achieve the results I 
envisioned... no, results far beyond that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Allow me to take this opportunity to 
express my gratitude. For making me into 
someone this 'strong'—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
――Now then! In honor of Eishin Flash's 
wonderful achievements, we have prepared 
this for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Right this way! Here you go!

"As the staff pulled back the curtain, 
revealed before them was—a memorial 
monument."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Well...

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text:
This is Eishin Flash-san's monument! Right 
in the center, we used a photo from when 
she conquered the Senior Year Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Um, the right words for this moment 
don't come to mind right away. But—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I am deeply honored. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Racetrack Staff
text_block_list.text: Congratulations so very much~!
And after the event ended—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I have a favor to ask...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Could you take a picture of me with the 
monument? I'd like to send it to my 
parents.
choice_data_list: Of course! I'll take it with my phone.
Of course! I'll take it with my phone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah, my apologies. Let me rephrase that.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to take a photo with you at the 
monument, Trainer-san... Would that be 
alright?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Now, with the two of you standing on 
either side of the monument—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, huh? Trainer-san, you're getting cut 
out of the frame...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I really should have had Falcon-san 
teach me how to take selfies."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. Somehow... we both managed to fit 
in the photo.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...By next time, I will be sure to master 
the art of taking selfies.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We still have many race schedules 
remaining ahead of us.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let us achieve even greater results among 
them, and have another monument erected 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
“—As long as the two of us are together, 
we can make anything a reality!”
